query: Investigate suspected revenue leakage on 2026-07 sugar imports at Lagos

executive.text: Manifest weights for 11 of 34 July sugar shipments at Lagos under-report against draft-survey estimates by an average 6.2%, corresponding to an estimated ₦412M in unpaid duty.

criticalFindings.title: Systematic manifest / draft-survey delta on 11 shipments

patterns.pattern: Same surveyor signs off on every under-reported shipment
Delta clusters between 5–8% — below the 10% audit trigger

analytical.text: The pattern is consistent with structured under-declaration to stay below the automatic audit threshold. Enforcement threshold met for administrative review; criminal referral requires interview evidence.

counterHypotheses: Legitimate moisture loss between load port and discharge.
Calibration drift on the port weighbridge, not under-declaration.
intelligenceGaps: Load-port draft survey copies for cross-check.
Surveyor licensing records and prior disciplinary history.

officerActions.label: Open administrative audit on AgriTrade Nigeria Ltd
Place next shipment under mandatory reweigh

nextQuestions: Which other importers use the same surveyor?
